content.topic: Risk factors and predisposing conditions for chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension (CTEPH)
content.summary: The page discusses risk factors and comorbidities associated with CTEPH, including a history of acute pulmonary embolism (reported by 75% of patients in an international registry), thrombophilic disorders (particularly antiphospholipid antibody syndrome and high coagulation factor VIII levels), cancer, history of splenectomy, inflammatory bowel disease, ventriculo-atrial shunts, infection of chronic i.v. lines and devices (e.g., pacemakers), non-O blood group, and hypothyroidism treated with thyroid hormones.
